_about: ONE plot-width sanity ceiling, read by BOTH app/src/components/chart/engine/__tests__/lineWidthCapParity.test.js (defSchema.validateDefinition over a member-door document) and tests/test_line_width_cap_parity.py (presentation_schema.presentation_errors). TradingView paints a Pine linewidth unclamped (set F: 1..10 is N px); the ceiling stops linewidth = 10000 from smearing the pane of everyone who installs a shared script. `as` = literal (plots[0].width is the number) or input (plots[0].width is $lineWidth and the input default is the number).
